account: It is day 0 at 08:00, and I am at my house. I have not yet seen anyone or heard any news today, so I have no concrete evidence of anything unusual, who might be involved, or what their purpose might be. I have lately felt that something is happening in town without my knowledge, but that is only a suspicion. My first priority is to go to the town hall, read my appointment book, and keep my appointments. I can then ask people I trust what they have actually seen or heard, without treating rumor as fact.
